context: The apartment-building entrance, late afternoon. Mrs. Mori catches Riku coming home with a hair colour he very much didn't have yesterday.
purpose: neighbourhood observation — affectionate prying that Riku can't escape

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: あら、リクくん、髪、変わった？
lines.en: Oh — Riku-kun, did your hair change?
lines.style: Voice spikes. Mid-volume Kansai. Has been waiting at the gate.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Caught in mid-step. Mumbled. Pulls his hood up half-instinctively in the voice.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: お母さん、見たんか、それ？
lines.en: Has your mom seen that yet?
lines.style: A question that is half a forecast. Eyes narrowed in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: One word. A whole near-future visible in it.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: ふふ。今日、覚悟しときや。
lines.style: A small laugh. Affectionate, mock-warning to the kid.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: A real laugh, brief. The neighbourhood-aunt energy got him.
